rows: Equipment: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) unit LT-1003838 LTI
Procedure: Annual maintenance of the UPS unit (I1-Y1)

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the uninterruptible power supply (UPS) unit (three-phase)
This document was prepared and the field test carried out by Eng. Essam Ahmed Ahmed Osman, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Diaa El-Din El-Gabalawy, General Manager of High Dam Power Station

The purpose of the UPS unit is to increase the reliability of the available AC supply. The required electrical energy storage is provided by a bank of internal or external batteries. These batteries can only store DC energy, whereas critical loads require AC energy. The UPS unit performs this conversion from DC to regulated AC

rows: Issue a work permit and a work order, with site personnel carrying the occupational safety and health category card
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs

The annual maintenance of the UPS unit is carried out after it is fully disconnected, with the load supplied through the bypass, in accordance with the UPS disconnection manoeuvre for the annual maintenance works
Wait at least 5 minutes after disconnecting the UPS unit and before starting any work inside the UPS cabinet, until the capacitor circuit is discharged
Note when carrying out testing that the manual bypass path is still live, through the bypass input cables and around the bypass, the AC output supply branch and the manual bypass switch
Before carrying out any dismantling or assembly work — if any — verify with the measuring instrument that the parts are disconnected and voltage-free
PPE such as safety helmet and safety belt, etc.
Remove the ventilation filters ("cover and right side of the unit") and clean them outside the room using a blower, and replace any damaged ones if found
Clean inside the UPS cabinet using a blower after opening the rear and front sides
Check the fixing terminals of all connections inside the unit, except the live connections referred to in item 3 of the safety precautions
Verify that all electronic cards and the connections between them are sound and firmly fixed

Fit the rear cover of the unit ("contains ----- cooling") and start the unit in accordance with the "manoeuvre" for connecting the UPS unit after completion of the maintenance works while the load is supplied from the bypass, in the following order: a- Connect the AC input switch and wait until the capacitor circuit is charged after about 20 seconds; b- Measure the charger input voltage on the AC input cable, within 380 V; c- Measure the charger output voltage, Rectifier DC input, by connecting the measuring instrument to the DC capacitor terminals at the bottom of the cabinet on the right side, on terminal "+42" for capacitors No. "29" and on terminal "-43" for capacitors No. "30"; the voltage shall be within 405 V DC
Connect the battery switch (Safety switch) and measure the battery voltage inside the UPS cabinet on the DC terminal block; it shall be within 380 V
Connect the battery output breaker (DC o/p breaker)
Carry out a reset by pressing the yellow button, then press both red tripping buttons together
Connect the static switch and wait until the cooling fans operate
Connect the AC output switch inside the UPS cabinet
Disconnect the manual bypass switch inside the UPS cabinet
Connect the inverter by pressing the green connection button
After the message "Load on inverter" appears, measure the inverter output on the AC output cable
Fit the cabinet sides and record the input and output voltage and current readings from the display screen
Measure the charging current from the battery room using a DC clamp meter

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the uninterruptible power supply (UPS) unit (three-phase)
This document was prepared and the field test carried out by Eng. Essam Ahmed Ahmed Osman, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Diaa El-Din El-Gabalawy, General Manager of High Dam Power Station
The purpose of the UPS unit is to increase the reliability of the available AC supply. The required electrical energy storage is provided by a bank of internal or external batteries. These batteries can only store DC energy, whereas critical loads require AC energy. The UPS unit performs this conversion from DC to regulated AC
Safety Precautions
Issue a work permit and a work order, with site personnel carrying the occupational safety and health category card | 
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs | 
The annual maintenance of the UPS unit is carried out after it is fully disconnected, with the load supplied through the bypass, in accordance with the UPS disconnection manoeuvre for the annual maintenance works | 
Wait at least 5 minutes after disconnecting the UPS unit and before starting any work inside the UPS cabinet, until the capacitor circuit is discharged | 
Note when carrying out testing that the manual bypass path is still live, through the bypass input cables and around the bypass, the AC output supply branch and the manual bypass switch | 
Before carrying out any dismantling or assembly work — if any — verify with the measuring instrument that the parts are disconnected and voltage-free | 
Tools and Equipment
Portable earthing, voltage indicator | 
PPE such as safety helmet and safety belt, etc. | 
Portable air blower | 
Digital multimeter, Fluk 77 model | 
DC clamp meter | 
Set of screwdrivers | 
Work to be Carried Out
Remove the ventilation filters ("cover and right side of the unit") and clean them outside the room using a blower, and replace any damaged ones if found | 1.
Clean inside the UPS cabinet using a blower after opening the rear and front sides | 2.
Check the fixing terminals of all connections inside the unit, except the live connections referred to in item 3 of the safety precautions | 3.
Verify that all electronic cards and the connections between them are sound and firmly fixed | 4.
Fit the rear cover of the unit ("contains ----- cooling") and start the unit in accordance with the "manoeuvre" for connecting the UPS unit after completion of the maintenance works while the load is supplied from the bypass, in the following order: a- Connect the AC input switch and wait until the capacitor circuit is charged after about 20 seconds; b- Measure the charger input voltage on the AC input cable, within 380 V; c- Measure the charger output voltage, Rectifier DC input, by connecting the measuring instrument to the DC capacitor terminals at the bottom of the cabinet on the right side, on terminal "+42" for capacitors No. "29" and on terminal "-43" for capacitors No. "30"; the voltage shall be within 405 V DC | 5.
Connect the battery switch (Safety switch) and measure the battery voltage inside the UPS cabinet on the DC terminal block; it shall be within 380 V | 6.
Connect the battery output breaker (DC o/p breaker) | 7.
Carry out a reset by pressing the yellow button, then press both red tripping buttons together | 8.
Connect the static switch and wait until the cooling fans operate | 9.
Connect the AC output switch inside the UPS cabinet | 10.
Disconnect the manual bypass switch inside the UPS cabinet | 11.
Connect the inverter by pressing the green connection button | 12.
After the message "Load on inverter" appears, measure the inverter output on the AC output cable | 13.
Fit the cabinet sides and record the input and output voltage and current readings from the display screen | 14.
Measure the charging current from the battery room using a DC clamp meter | 15.
